plain-worn.label: Plain Cloak worn, unidentified Cloak of Aman carried
plain-worn.explanation: Original: the random-power check asks about the worn plain Cloak (no ego, no random power), so the Cloak of Aman counts as safe to sell; the Borg picks it for the Black Market (shop 6, item a) and the real sale hands it over ('You had a Cloak of Aman [1,+14] <+1> (a).'), learning the nether rune only as it goes. Corrected: the check asks about the Cloak of Aman itself and the Borg sells nothing.

aman-worn.label: Control: Cloak of Aman worn, unidentified Cloak of Aman carried
aman-worn.explanation: The worn cloak and the carried one have the same random-power ego, so both versions give the same answer: nothing is sold. The changed check runs in both versions; the logs are byte-identical.
